info.title: Twitch authentication (id.twitch.tv)
info.description: Written from Twitch's authentication pages (spec/SOURCE.md): the token endpoint and its grants, token validation and revocation, and the device code request. The authorize page (id.twitch.tv/oauth2/authorize) is a screen.

post.description: To get the tokens, send an HTTP POST request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token. The client credentials grant answers an app access token; the authorization code grant trades the code the authorize page sent the redirect URI for a user access token and a refresh token; the refresh token grant answers a new access token and refresh token; the device code grant trades a device code the user authorized.

code.description: The code that the /authorize response returned in the code query parameter.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token issued to the client.

device_code.description: The code that will authenticate the user.

200.description: If the request succeeds, it returns an access token.

401.description: The refresh token is no longer valid.

get.description: To validate a token, send an HTTP GET request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/validate.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: OAuth <access token to validate goes here>; the Bearer prefix may be used in place of OAuth.

200.description: If the token is valid, the request returns HTTP status code 200.

401.description: If the token is not valid, the request returns HTTP status code 401.

post.description: If your app no longer needs an access token, you can revoke it by sending an HTTP POST request to https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/revoke.

200.description: If the revocation succeeds, the request returns HTTP status code 200 OK (with no body).

400.description: 400 Bad Request if the client ID is valid but the access token is not.

404.description: 404 Not Found if the client ID is not valid.

post.summary: Start the device code grant flow
post.description: This cURL command starts a device authorization grant code flow for your client.

200.description: The response to this call will contain the device code.

client_id.description: The Client ID associated with the access token.

login.description: The lowercase username for the user associated with the access token. If the access token is an App Access Token, this field will be null.

scopes.description: A list of scopes granted to the access token.

user_id.description: The user ID associated with the access token. If the access token is an App Access Token, this field will be null.

expires_in.description: The amount of seconds from now in which the token will expire.
